application_type_full: Householder planning & demolition in a conservation area
description: Demolition of the existing garage and erection of a single storey garage and replacement boundary wall and gate
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted ( S01; EX01; EX02; PL01; PL02 and Design & Access statement Burlington Gardens AUG 2021;  Received:  25 August 2021 ) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials used shall be as specified in the submitted Design & Access statement Burlington Gardens AUG 2021

Condition : 4 - The gates hereby approved shall be of a simple open vertical rail design as shown on the approved elevations and the faces of the gates shall not be infilled with obstructions to visibility.  The gates shall be designed to open inwards only and shall be so maintained permanently.
